packetText:
# Slide 8 — The Tool Stack Already Exists

## Status

- current deck numbering: slide 8
- legacy source mapping: same as current
- decision state: OPEN

## Why this slide exists

- make the talk practical
- show that good microlearning does not require futuristic infrastructure
- set up the AI section that follows

## Locked slide thesis

Programs can start microlearning now using tools that already exist.

## Slide purpose brief

- top claim:
  the stack is already here
- support claim:
  Anki, mobile tools, LMS flows, and curated FOAM can cover most starting needs
- non-goals:
  - do not make this an app marketplace slide
  - do not imply all tools are equally mature

## Figure job

- organize the stack cleanly
- distinguish now versus emerging
- keep the slide modern and practical

## Locked copy

- header:
  `The tool stack already exists.`
- subheader:
  `Anki, mobile apps, LMS workflows, and curated FOAM can start today.`
- figure labels:
  - `now`
  - `next`
  - `emerging`

## Visual rules

- maturity or capability framing
- no screenshot wall
- avoid gadget worship

## Existing useful source assets

- `inputs/microlearning_emergency_medicine_review.md`
- `inputs/saem_microlearning_talk_outline.md`

## Immediate next refinement

- test a maturity stack
- compare a ladder versus clustered capability map
